Review this pull request. The repository at the PR head is your working directory; the base commit is `66a9ee4c6b696d4d55b493edb850954c816fc8b4` (`git diff 66a9ee4c6b69...HEAD` shows the change). Issue #1: fenced_code + attr_list: `linenums` on a code block crashes with TypeError unless codehilite is enabled I use `fenced_code` together with `attr_list` and turned off `codehilite` because we highlight on the client with highlight.js. Some of our older docs still have `linenums` on their fenced blocks from when we used Pygments, and now the build blows up on them. Minimal example: ```python import markdown src = "``` { .python linenums }\nprint(1)\n```" markdown.markdown(src, extensions=["fenced_code", "attr_list"]) ``` ``` Traceback (most recent call last): ... TypeError: cannot serialize None (type NoneType) ``` `linenums="true"` gives `TypeError: cannot serialize True (type bool)` instead. Same story with `guess_lang` and `noclasses`. Something like `data-x="1"` works fine, and if I add `codehilite` to the extensions everything renders. I'd expect the block to just render as a normal code block when codehilite isn't there, instead of the whole conversion failing. One stray attribute shouldn't take down the page. input.summary: The fix is correct and minimal. With fenced_code and attr_list but no codehilite, non-string Pygments options such as linenums are now left out of the output. Other attributes still render. The full suite passes.

own_checks.check: The issue's example no longer crashes and renders a plain code block
Other attributes are kept alongside bool options (data-x with linenums="true")
hl_lines, both inside attrs and in the legacy form outside them, does not crash without codehilite
Valueless non-bool attributes and a string value of "0" are still output, so existing behaviour is unchanged
own_checks.command: probes with data-n="0" title="a" and a bare data-n
own_checks.output_excerpt: data-n="0" title="a"; bare data-n renders data-n="data-n"

notes: The isinstance(v, str) filter also drops the list value of hl_lines without codehilite. Before the change this would have crashed, so dropping it is consistent with the fix.
The changelog entry has no issue number. The existing entries do.
The new tests cover the bare flag, explicit bool values, use_pygments="false" and a mix with another attribute. They do not cover hl_lines without codehilite.
